concerns.title: Bobby Galindo (1099) — XTO, NAIL TILLMAN E1G 507H, job 36503, ticket 102660, 09:09 AM to 11:58 AM — gas release during flow-line reconnection. From the OWL observe narrat
concerns.text: : "As the crew was reconnecting the flow line as well as the tubing noticed a hissing sound coming from the well itself. We told them to stop to assess the situation, it was then, we noticed gas was coming out. We had the crew to stay away from the area. Notified MT of the situation. MT noticed bolts were not tightened, therefore, had the cree tightened the bolts, but tested the well to make sure no gases were present. No gas detected and crew resumed work"

confirm.text: This reads as an actual release in which work was halted and the crew withdrawn, handled correctly on location. It is reported here as a real event rather than a selection to be confirmed. Note that the form's multi-select records only "Stop work authority was discussed" — "Stop work authority utilized" was not selected, although the narrative describes authority being exercised. The "One thing we'll do better next time" field was left blank. Follow-up: confirm whether this should be logged as a near miss, and correct the stop-work selection.

"Well was put back into service with a flange in the wrong spot. This caused it to leak, so we removed the flange and set new rings to fix the well."

Corroborated by "Details if Any: Removed flange that was in the wrong place and re torqued well back up." Follow-up: confirm the leak was contained and whether it warrants an incident record.
